text_block_list.text: Juhu! Geschafft! I have done it!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Eishin Flaaaaash! Congratulatiooons!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Danke schön! Thank you for your
support!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ah...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Flash!
text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother

text_block_list.text: Mother, Father. And... Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Thank you for watching over me...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш respectfully bows her head
at us. She
is absolutely radiant.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Papa, Mama!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It has been a very long time since you
have called
us that.
text_block_list.name: Flash's Father

text_block_list.text: Oh! I mean... Father, Mother.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: I'll excuse myself for a bit.

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to ruin the moment, so I
leave the
three of them alone for a
moment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Flash. You ran a superb
race.
text_block_list.name: Flash's Father

text_block_list.text: We're so proud of you.
text_block_list.name: Flash's Father

text_block_list.text:
Of course, you would be the apple of
our eye
even if you did nothing at all.
Nothing will change
that.
text_block_list.name: Flash's Father

text_block_list.text:
But you have forged your own path and
earned
our respect as your own person.
text_block_list.name: Flash's Father

text_block_list.text: Father...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Flash, you have blossomed so
wonderfully. I'm so
glad we came to see
you!
text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Your running was so spectacular, it
brought tears
to my eyes. You were truly
super, toll und klasse!
text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother

text_block_list.text: Thanks!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I have returned. Thank you for being so

considerate.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
They plan to do some sightseeing in
Tokyo, then
return to their hotel. Do
you think I can receive
permission to go
out tonight if I submit the form
now?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. I am counting on
you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
My parents said that they are proud of
me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It was an arduous journey with many
twists and
turns, but I have
accomplished my goal.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Had I strayed from my plan, I doubt I
would have
felt like I achieved so much.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And you were always there to encourage
me.
Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Her phrasing is so final that I can't bring myself to say anything to lighten the mood. After all, the end is nearing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My last remaining goal is the Arima
Kinen. I will
keep running, to the very
end...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
So let's put together the perfect
schedule for it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she intends to stick to her
original plan
and retire after the Arima
Kinen. If that's what she
wants, then it's
not my place to object.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Memories of her flying down the
racetrack flood
my mind's eye as I gaze
at her race schedule for
next year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
